item.description: President Donald Trump is facing new backlash following his order barring CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House. The three outlets are responding, filing a lawsuit to protect what they say are their First Amendment rights. It comes as Trump says he’s altering his plans for his 250-foot arch to include what he calls a “top-grade military complex.” NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

item.description: Hollywood is mourning the loss of Presley Gerber, the son of supermodel Cindy Crawford and businessman Rande Gerber. The 27-year-old died Sunday at a rehab facility, according to the LA County medical examiner. Gerber, who had followed in his famous mother’s footsteps working as a model since he was a teenager, was also very open in recent years about his difficult struggles with mental health issues and substance abuse. NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports for TODAY.
